lane_impact: L1 world-exploration: corrects the journal's farming-tables claim, which states a 15-minute grace before ROT across all four crop tiers. Three of four. The 12-hour crop is the safe overnight plant — it cannot be lost to inattention, which is a deliberate free-to-play design choice and exactly the kind of feel rule a port would silently get wrong if it applied the grace uniformly.
text: The 12-hour crop has no ROTTED state — its state machine is two-way (PLANTED, then READYFORHARVEST forever), unlike the 15-minute, 1-hour and 6-hour crops which all rot after a 900-second grace.

Separately confirmed and NOT in doubt: the web pool's namestarting and nameending runs match the android arrays in order and content with exactly the two absences a deduplicating pool predicts (Kiyo once instead of twice; 'i' and 'no' deduped), so the generator TABLES are cross-build consistent.
